audit: 2026-09-14 scheduled remote agent (fourth fire of the day): one 50-question batch spanning all four modules and the three active tiers (21 L3, 19 L4, 10 L5), published as 10 files of 5 questions because a single 350 KB file exceeds what one MCP call carries. Module split Paediatrics 13, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 13, Psychiatry 12, Medicine 12, keeping the four modules level at 1474/1474/1473/1473. Cell selection used the whole-bank denominator that Section 2 of the context file mandates; this run's first reading measured the tiers against the L3 to L5 subset and concluded L5 was in surplus at 6.5 per cent, which is the exact error Section 2 warns against, and it was corrected before any question was written. On the whole-bank denominator L5 stood at 274 of 5844 (4.69 per cent) against the 5 per cent target, an 18-question gap, so the batch carried 10 L5 weighted toward the modules with the largest L5 deficits and lifted the bank to 284 of 5894 (4.82 per cent). Clusters were chosen by probing subtopic_detail and correct-option text against the live bank for genuinely uncovered ground. Coverage added: Paediatrics on ankyloglossia frenotomy, pulled elbow, otitis media with effusion referral, cow milk protein formula escalation, positional plagiocephaly, infantile haemangioma, toddler's fracture, absence epilepsy drug choice, facial dog bite, Duchenne creatine kinase, salicylate dialysis threshold, lead chelation threshold and vesicoureteric reflux prophylaxis; Obstetrics and Gynaecology on velamentous cord insertion, carpal tunnel in pregnancy, early glucose tolerance testing in obesity, imperforate hymen, episiotomy angle, listeriosis, parvovirus B19 surveillance, cytomegalovirus avidity, Mullerian agenesis, deinfibulation timing, anal sphincter injury grading, antithyroid drug switching and lamotrigine clearance; Psychiatry on premenstrual dysphoric disorder, trichotillomania, night terrors, retentive soiling, restless legs versus akathisia, antidepressant hyponatraemia, corrected QT prolongation, delusional misidentification, delusional infestation, corticosteroid-induced mania, post-traumatic brain injury aggression and autoimmune encephalitis; Medicine on achalasia sequencing, eosinophilic oesophagitis escalation, alpha-1 antitrypsin testing, occupational asthma confirmation, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy manoeuvres, engineered stone silicosis, constrictive pericarditis, pulmonary hypertension catheterisation, long QT syndrome, Brugada unmasked by fever, rheumatic mitral stenosis in pregnancy and checkpoint inhibitor colitis. No L2 generated. scripts/dupe_gate.py passed with zero duplicates on the first run. Correct-answer letters are exactly even at 10 per letter, and every pushed file was verified against the remote by blob SHA. Standing note for the maintainer, now raised by three consecutive fires: raw argmax over the 12 cells still never selects an L5 cell, because the frozen legacy L2 stock leaves every L3 and L4 cell with a 12 to 15 point deficit against L5's 0.3 to 0.5, and the same argmax run to 50 picks would also breach the Section 2 module-balance rule by loading 26 questions into a single module; this fire therefore applied the per-batch tier aim and the module-balance directive over raw argmax. The selection rule needs an explicit L5 floor and an explicit module-balance constraint written into it to be self-consistent. Separately, the routine prompt's claim that the sandbox blocks git push did not hold this run: a dry run was rejected only as a non-fast-forward, so the manifest and meta commit went via git push per Section 9 of the context file rather than through the MCP, which avoided hand-transcribing 610 manifest paths.
